content.raw:
Leading the way to urban clean energy

Pioneering sustainable power solutions to build cleaner, greener cities.

Delivering battery
energy storage for
the New York City
area

We are the leading developer of community-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) in the New York City metropolitan area. With sites in the Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens and Staten Island as well as Westchester County and Long Island, NineDot Energy is helping to make our local power grid cleaner, more resilient, more equitable and less costly, supporting New York’s energy transition.

Delivering real projects, real news

Empowering Electric Mobility

Host a Blink station and join the EV revolution!

Become an EV charging hub, attract new customers, and create an additional revenue stream from charging fees.

Change the world. One charger at a time.

Contact Us
